scope.description: A Raft node receiving an InstallSnapshot whose last included index is below log entries the node already holds. The obligation concerns the receiver's log after the snapshot is installed, not the snapshot transport or the FSM restore.
assumptions: The FSM restore succeeds and lastApplied and the snapshot index are adopted from the request.
The receiver's log store is not a monotonic store that removes all old logs (that branch empties the store but still leaves the in-memory last log as it was).
excluded: The leader's choice to send a snapshot rather than entries.
Log safety of the entries themselves; the question is the receiver's bookkeeping.

properties.reason: Independent applicability, correlated prerequisites and fully observed result comparison

adaptations: installSnapshot and appendEntries are invoked directly on their main-thread code paths because skipStartup leaves no main loop; in production processRPC dispatches both from the transport consumer channel.
An explicit substitute goroutine answers restore futures with success because runFSM is not running; it never inspects or modifies log, snapshot or term state.

The log content is written to the caller-owned LogStore before NewRaft and the snapshot payload is synthetic because the harness FSM ignores content; conf.TrailingLogs is 0 so compaction runs at the snapshot index.

plan_uncertainties: Real-leader reachability of the retained-tail state.
The leader's subsequent behaviour (nextIndex decrement, repeated snapshots) was not measured.
Whether the rejection is transient in a deployment depends on the same premise.
grounding_unresolved: Duration and any consequence of the window.
Whether a real leader drives a follower into the retained-tail state; the check seeds it.
What the leader does next (decrementing nextIndex and possibly re-sending a snapshot) was not measured; the check reports the receiver's decision only.

blockers: Open review issue 7bcba806871948e49b8891aa6bd2c2b7 [S57,S58,S54,S8]: The snapshot protocol requires discarding the log whenever the receiver cannot confirm the snapshot's last included entry, while this implementation relies on a later AppendEntries to truncate the tail.
